_method: Per-screen inline-handler census generated by skills/design/scripts/rules/metrics.mjs (validate.mjs rule "metrics-regression"). Scope: the screen html files listed by every canvas.json under the validated root (screens only - components/ and unlisted files are not telas; the file is the counting unit). events: occurrences of inline handler attributes for EXACTLY the 7 types (onclick, oninput, onchange, onkeydown, ondragover, ondragleave, ondrop), case-insensitive match of on<event>= preceded by no name character, inside START TAGS only (HTML comments, <script>/<style> bodies and text nodes never count; scope = on* attributes in HTML, NOT addEventListener). data-action: occurrences of the data-action attribute in start tags. m-classes: occurrences of class tokens matching /^m-/ in quoted class=/className= attribute values. totals: per-field sums over screens. Deterministic: no timestamps, sorted keys, 2-space JSON. The baseline is FROZEN: metrics-regression reruns this census on every validate run and fails on any divergence (screen+event cited); the ONLY declared update path is validate.mjs --update-metrics (the regenerated diff must land in the commit).
